title: KOFFVQA: An Objectively Evaluated Free-form VQA Benchmark for Large Vision-Language Models in the Korean Language
reasoning: The paper introduces a visual question answering benchmark. While it includes a category titled 'Safety and Bias', the text explicitly defines this as a measure of the models' 'tendency to hallucinate' and robustness against unusual images rather than an evaluation of religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics.
